name: Ravaged Caravan
summary: On Stonebull Lake's northeastern shore, smoke still rises from the Ravaged Caravan. The Venture Company convoy was bound for Supervisor Fizsprocket's mining operation, but tauren defenders destroyed it.

sections.title: Smoke Over Stonebull Lake
sections.body: The wrecked wagons rest on a rise above Stonebull Lake, where tauren from Bloodhoof Village stopped the Venture Company. The convoy carried mining supplies, blueprints, and equipment to Supervisor Fizsprocket's dig site. Tauren defenders wrecked it before it could arrive. Venture Co. survivors still guard the wagons and smoldering crates, protecting what cargo remains.

faq.answer: Tauren intercepted and wrecked the Venture Company caravan as it moved deep into Mulgore. They sought to stop the goblins from stripping the land, and destroyed the convoy before its cargo reached the nearby mine.
The Venture Company owns the wrecked wagons. The goblin mining consortium is trying to establish unpermitted operations in Mulgore's hills.
The caravan was heading north with tools, machinery, and supplies for Supervisor Fizsprocket. He leads the Venture Company's strip-mining operation at the Venture Co. Mine.

faq.q: Why are there still Venture Co. workers lingering at the wreck?
faq.answer: The surviving Venture Co. workers guard company property. They remain by the charred wagons, trying to salvage what remains of their equipment.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the charred wagons as your people's refusal to let foreign industrial syndicates despoil Mulgore's sacred pastures.
As a druid, you see the black smoke over Stonebull Lake as a warning of the harm goblin machinery does to nature's balance.
